note: 'my belly is like unvented wine; it is about to burst like a new wineskin' -- ground: full to bursting with words (32:18)
'Moab has been at ease from youth, settled like wine on its dregs' -- ground: undisturbed, unchanged (the oracle is the LORD's, 48:1)
'they will be drunk on their own blood, as with wine' -- ground: drunk on it
'Ephraim will be like a mighty man, and their hearts will be glad as with wine' -- ground: gladness of heart
'your mouth like the finest wine' (the man to the woman; her mouth is the tenor) -- ground: it flows smoothly
'I have become like a drunkard, like a man overcome by wine, because of the LORD' -- the image is the existing drunken man, wine only inside it
